title: How to Win, or Sure Secrets of Success
author: L. H. Anderson
description: How to Win, or Sure Secrets of Success by Professor L. H. Anderson, a self-help manual issued in several editions (the copy here is marked fifth edition, 13,000) and arranged particularly for the students of the Chicago College of Psycho-Therapeutics and the National Institute of Science. Typical of the late nineteenth-century American success literature that grew out of mesmerism and New Thought, it teaches that success depends on cultivating personal magnetism, will power, concentration, self-confidence and positive mental attitude. Chapters give practical rules for health, habits, conversation, business dealings and influencing others, mixing commonsense advice with claims about mental and magnetic forces. It is a companion to the author's Ancient Magic, Magnetism and Psychic Forces and a period source for the roots of modern motivational and mind-power writing.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. One format was converted from the other (PDF from EPUB).
